BODY_SIGNATURE_ONLY.summary: The frozen miner recorded the PyTorch runtime signature, but the committed title alone does not carry the full error text.
BODY_SIGNATURE_ONLY.when_used: Use when the record is still a valid offline mining signal but would require refetching the issue/PR body before entering a precision/recall gold split.

CLEAR_SIGNATURE.summary: The committed title or metadata contains an unambiguous tensor runtime signature.
CLEAR_SIGNATURE.when_used: Use for records whose visible metadata is enough to audit the inclusion/root-cause decision without extra context.

DATA_OR_PREPROCESS.summary: The title suggests input formatting, preprocessing, or dataset shape as the proximate cause.
DATA_OR_PREPROCESS.when_used: Use when the tensor error is plausibly in scope, but the root is outside a model-layer architectural contract.

DEPENDENCY_OR_DOCS.summary: The title suggests dependency churn, documentation, API/schema text, or workflow metadata rather than a tensor execution bug.
DEPENDENCY_OR_DOCS.when_used: Use when the generic signature match should not be treated as a positive bug label without refetching source evidence.

ENVIRONMENT_DEVICE.summary: The title ties the failure to device placement or accelerator environment.
ENVIRONMENT_DEVICE.when_used: Use for CPU/CUDA/MPS/XPU placement records, especially when a runtime environment is part of the reported symptom.

FIX_LINK_ONLY.summary: A PR or fix-style title indicates a possible repair but not enough standalone evidence for a gold positive label.
FIX_LINK_ONLY.when_used: Use for records accepted as provenance links but deferred from directly scored positive labels.

GENERIC_INPUT_TYPE_PHRASE.summary: The phrase 'Input type' is overloaded and may refer to non-tensor APIs.
GENERIC_INPUT_TYPE_PHRASE.when_used: Use for dtype/device-input candidates where the signature is too generic to classify from title-only metadata.

NON_ENGLISH_OR_MINIMAL_TITLE.summary: The title is non-English, very short, or otherwise too sparse for root-cause adjudication.
NON_ENGLISH_OR_MINIMAL_TITLE.when_used: Use when the runtime signature keeps the row useful, but title-only review cannot confidently localize the cause.

OVERLAP_SHAPE_DEVICE_DTYPE.summary: Multiple TensorGuard domains could plausibly explain the record.
OVERLAP_SHAPE_DEVICE_DTYPE.when_used: Use when the final inclusion decision is positive but the domain/root-cause label is intentionally conservative.

PR_METADATA_AMBIGUOUS.summary: The PR metadata is too generic to show the bug without the frozen signature match.
PR_METADATA_AMBIGUOUS.when_used: Use for pull requests whose titles name a broad change, cleanup, or fixture rather than the tensor failure itself.
